name: elagoht/meta
description: A collage plugin that writes the tags a page is shared and indexed by into its head: Open Graph, Twitter cards, the canonical URL, the meta description, and the page's translations.
setup: Canonical URLs and images are absolute, so it needs the site's origin: set `BASE_URL` in a project `collage new` made (it becomes `Config.BaseURL`), or register an origin resolver such as `elagoht/tenant`. Without one the application does not start.

config.description: A collage plugin that writes the tags a page is shared and indexed by into its head: Open Graph, Twitter cards, the canonical URL, the meta description, and the page's translations.

defaultImage.description: DefaultImage is the og:image of a page that names none: a path on the site, made absolute with the site's origin, or an absolute URL.

locales.description: Locales maps a collage locale to the og:locale it is written as: "en" to "en_US". A locale not in it is written as it is, with "-" made "_".

noAlternates.description: NoAlternates leaves out the <link rel="alternate" hreflang> tags, for a site whose layout writes its own.

twitterSite.description: TwitterSite is the site's own account, "@example", sent as twitter:site.
